title: Scoring What Matters: Exact Feedback Reduction for Language Model Comparison
abstract: arXiv:2611.31931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Comparing language-model checkpoints requires estimating performance differences, yet evaluation pipelines can pay to score responses whose contributions cancel from those differences. We introduce Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition (CAFA), a sampler-agnostic method that identifies which scores a requested linear report needs before acquiring feedback. CAFA groups identical scoring inputs and aggregates their report coefficients, removing queries beyond ordinary caching while preserving the fully scored result. For a fixed response bank and an otherwise unrestricted scalar scorer, we characterize necessary and sufficient query sets for exact recovery of sample means, either alone or jointly with ordinary sample covariances. On controlled updates, CAFA removes 55.8% and 90.1% of the scoring inputs remaining after caching for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct, respectively, averaged over four generation repetitions. translated_title: 对关键内容评分：面向语言模型比较的精确反馈缩减
translated_abstract: 比较语言模型检查点需要估计性能差异，然而评估流程可能会花费代价去评分那些其贡献在这些差异中相互抵消的响应。我们提出对比感知反馈获取（Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition, CAFA），这是一种与采样器无关的方法，可在获取反馈之前识别所请求的线性报告需要哪些评分。CAFA 将相同的评分输入分组并聚合其报告系数，在保留完整评分结果的同时，移除了超出普通缓存机制之外的多余查询。针对固定的响应库和不受其他限制的标量评分器，我们刻画了精确恢复样本均值（无论是单独恢复还是与普通样本协方差联合恢复）的必要且充分查询集合。在受控更新实验中，经过四次生成重复取平均，CAFA 分别为 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 移除了缓存后剩余评分输入的 55.8% 和 90.1%。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出对比感知反馈获取方法CAFA，通过分组相同评分输入并聚合报告系数，在精确保持样本统计量的前提下，最高可去除语言模型比较中90.1%的多余评分查询。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition (CAFA), which groups identical scoring inputs and aggregates report coefficients to exactly eliminate redundant feedback queries in language model comparison, removing up to 90.1% of scoring inputs while preserving exact sample statistics.
